rationale: The 2022+ terminal partition (2022-01-03 to 2026-09-03, N=1,154 sessions) was previously loaded, evaluated, and published in Phase 9 Step 4 (news incremental value), Phase 10 (regime diagnostics), and Phase 11 Stage 2 (strategy evaluation). Most crucially, the catastrophic failure of Model 1 on the 2022+ holdout under Open-to-Close execution (-27.17% net loss) was the direct, formative impetus for creating Phase 12 (Target Redesign). Therefore, the 2022+ dataset cannot be scientifically represented as a pristine, untouched confirmatory holdout. However, the dedicated Snapshot B T0 model (trained on Open-to-Close returns with N*=43) was never trained on or evaluated against the 2022+ period. A frozen, non-optimized evaluation of this model on the 2022+ partition is scientifically permissible strictly as a RETROSPECTIVE OUT-OF-SAMPLE EVALUATION.

1_targets_previously_read_or_calculated.details: Phase 5 generated Close-to-Close targets; Phase 9, 10, 11 loaded and evaluated targets through 2026-09-04.

2_predictions_previously_generated.details: Phase 9 Step 4 generated Model 0-3 predictions; Phase 10 generated Model 1 diagnostics; Phase 11 generated strategy trade signals.

3_metrics_or_returns_previously_calculat.details: Phase 9 calculated LogLoss and IC; Phase 10 calculated RMSE and regime IC; Phase 11 calculated trading returns and Sharpe ratios.

4_influenced_subsequent_decisions.details: Phase 9 holdout results sealed the exclusion of News features; Phase 11 holdout strategy collapse directly triggered the Phase 12 target redesign.

5_snapshot_b_t0_specifically_evaluated.details: The realized T0 return series was traded in Phase 11, but using predictions from a T1-trained model. A model trained specifically on T0 has never been evaluated on 2022+.

6_phase13_step1_protocol_assumption.details: Phase 13 Step 1 labeled 2022+ an 'untouched confirmatory holdout'. This label was historically inaccurate. The protocol remains computationally valid under the corrected 'PREVIOUSLY EXPOSED RETROSPECTIVE EVALUATION DATA' classification.

gate_decision.mandatory_condition: All findings must be strictly reported as retrospective out-of-sample diagnostics with zero claim of untouched confirmatory validation.
